examples.detection_method: Email gateway and sandboxing detected macro-enabled document with suspicious AutoOpen macro invoking PowerShell download from known malicious IP. Network IDS flagged HTTP GET request to rare IP hosting known malware payload. Endpoint detection system logged suspicious PowerShell execution with encoded command-line invocation. Correlation of domain registration data and SPF pass with anomalous domain name similarity triggered threat intel alert on possible spear phishing.
